description: Recent Solana token-flow activity for one wallet or token mint: per-transaction token balance deltas with direction, counterparties, an activity read (transfer, swap, mint_burn) and RPC provenance, over a bounded window. $0.02/call via x402 (Solana or Base) or MPP; repeat calls are cache-backed.

activity.description: Keep only transactions of this read: transfer, swap (a public DEX program was involved), mint_burn.

address.description: Solana wallet owner or token mint (base58).

before.description: Signature cursor from a previous response (cursor.before) to page further back.

direction.description: For a wallet subject: keep transactions where the wallet received (in) or sent (out) tokens.

limit.description: Most recent transactions scanned; filters apply within them. Page with cursor.before.

mint.description: Keep only transactions that moved this mint.

name: token_flow_activity
